title: Figure 17. Schematic diagram of a 16-column microfluidic DNA synthesizer
description: Two-part schematic: (A) a reagent controller, herringbone binary tree, and column array drawn with red control lines, blue fluidic lines, yellow herringbone mixers, and green reactor columns; (B) a close-up of four reaction columns with valve legend entries such as "normal valve," "sieve valve," and "compression valve." Captioned "Figure 17. (A) Schematic diagram of a 16-column microfluidic DNA synthesizer... (B) Close up schematic of the column array (106)."
